outline:
Course Description
Introduction to multi-media sampling techniques and analytical methods for evaluation outdoor/indoor air, soil/surfaces, and water. The course will also emphasize environmental investigative techniques, instrument selection, and quality control, including documentation, calibration, and sample management.

Course Goals
This course will provide an introduction to multi-media sampling techniques and analytical methods for evaluation outdoor/indoor air, soil/surfaces, and water. By the end of the semester, students who complete all necessary assignments will be able to:
1.	Collect samples in their research and in their professions.
2.	Identify and quantify environmental pollution.
3.	Defend their data and can base good decisions on their measurements.
schedule:

2. Introduction and fundamental to environmental analysis
3. Quality assurance and quality control
4. measurement uncertainty
5. Figures and tables

8. Field trip to Taipei Water Department
9. Mid-term exam
10. Waste analysis
11. Water quality analysis
12. TCLP&R222
13. Soil quality analysis
14.	Air quality analysis
15.	Field trip to air quality monitoring station
16.	Case study of environmental analysis
17. Final report

category: 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
證照培訓與專業講習(Certificate training and professional lectures)
flexible_learning.content: 第17至18週採彈性學習方式進行，學生可依個人興趣與專業發展方向，自行選擇與課程相關之校內外專題演講、研討會、線上講座或學術論壇至少兩場參與。透過專家分享最新研究成果、產業發展趨勢及實務案例，培養學生自主學習能力，拓展專業視野，並將演講內容與課程知識相互連結，提升跨領域思考與終身學習能力。
flexible_learning.outcome:
學生須於彈性學習期間完成至少兩場演講之聆聽，並繳交每場約500字之心得報告，共計兩篇（約1,000字）。心得內容建議包含：

演講主題與內容摘要。
個人學習收穫與心得反思。
演講內容與本課程知識之關聯性。
未來可應用於學習、研究或實務工作之啟發。

assessment:
1. Mid-Term exam (30%)
2. Final report (30%)
3. Experiment (20%): water, air, and waste
4. Participation (10%): 2 times visiting
5. Self-study (10%): 2 reports
